honest_summary: All 20 tui-core files are ported and the crate compiles and passes 174 tests. Behaviour is preserved for the parsing, layout, diffing and rendering paths; the JavaScript runtime pieces that have no direct Rust equivalent are adapted rather than copied: the nextTick/setTimeout render schedule is exposed as explicit schedule_render()/run_pending_render() calls, terminal input/resize callbacks are queued and drained by the owner, overlay handles record intent in shared cells applied by sync_overlays(), and AbortSignal is a small port-local flag type. No TypeScript function is missing; a few helpers are private instead of public. Not verified: real terminal interaction and the fullscreen dock against a live terminal.
